name: model/search
description: Search HuggingFace for base models by name, architecture, or size. Used to find compaction targets (e.g., 'Qwen 3.5 27B'). Different from adapter/search which finds LoRA adapters.

params.name: minSize
params.description: Minimum model size in billions of parameters (e.g., 7, 14, 27)

params.name: maxSize
params.description: Maximum model size in billions of parameters

results.name: models
results.description: Array of { id, author, downloads, likes, tags, pipeline_tag, lastModified }
